title: Great space saver.
text: Great space saver.. I love this holder. It fits perfectly in the odd space in the fridge that no one likes to use because its small and things get pushed back and lost..the perfect holder for my cans.

product_metadata.title: Copco Clear Plastic Can Bin, 14-inch
features: SMART STORAGE: Keeps soda and beer cans neat and accessible in your refrigerator
SPACE-SAVING: Narrow design maximizes space and keeps refrigerator organized.
PORTABLE: Built-in handle for easy transportation to and from the refrigerator
LARGE CAPACITY: Easily holds up to 10 cans
description: The Copco Clear Bin keeps up to 10 soda or beer cans neat, organized, and easily accessible in your refrigerator. The narrow design of the bin saves space, and it features a built-in handle, which allows for easy transport to and from the refrigerator. Measures 14 x 6 x 3.8 inches. To clean, wipe with a damp cloth.
